messages.subject_clean: Issues with shiny app under safari
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am been developing shiny apps to generate diagrams with DiagrammeR locally without any issue. But when uploaded the app on shinyapp.io <http://shinyapp.io> started experiencing serious issues with the rendering of the diagram color. With safari (the diagram shows black)
 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-F21xyEfmmgk/WBpSxWJGGBI/AAAAAAAAB14/F2DuigFJfjA15PbgrfhRO5Ykll0lSUjwACLcB/s1600/under_safari_%255Bbug%255D.png>

With chrome (the correct color gradient can be seen)

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-qjJnyQ6eqx0/WBpTKsQ7FII/AAAAAAAAB18/m2RpXE7EbEkoDJjrXYDtRMsbfMT6FMHvgCLcB/s1600/under_chrome_%255Bnormal%255D.png>I generated a simple reproducible example (code attached). I cannot see any error or warning from the shinyapp.io <http://shinyapp.io> log (see below). The app can be tested at: https://guiastrennec.shinyapps.io/diagrammer_bug/. Any suggestions on the cause of this issue are welcome.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-oexGdzIBO1k/WBpU9Nr1NHI/AAAAAAAAB2I/1ga2ugk_JZEN8ApnNZACRLqxv6pgWPobgCLcB/s1600/app_log.png>

I'm using MySQL 'world' database. My app is fetching table from a database. The app is also working on column selection using checkbox option. I want to filter result row-wise further. library(DBI)
library(ggplot2)

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      conditionalPanel(
        'input.dataset === "Data"',
        checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', p(style = "font-family:Arial Black", "Select columns:"),
                           names(Data), selected = names(Data))
      ),
      # Create a new Row in the UI for selectInputs
